cohort: Live term macrosomic babies delivered at KIST Medical College Teaching Hospital, Lalitpur, Nepal.
finding: Neonatal sepsis was the major cause of morbidity in macrosomic babies.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and instrumental delivery were significantly associated with neonatal complications.
birth_weight: Macrosomic (defined using a local intrauterine fetal growth percentile curve according to gestational age)
